about: General (standard/largest-employer) minimum wage changes, 2000-01-01 through 2026-01-01, federal and 56 places. rateMinor is cents. DOL history table is Jan 1 year-values, so rows with a year-only date carry `estimated`. Where a state's rate is below federal, the state's own rate is recorded and the federal floor governs. Tiered states: upper/largest-employer tier recorded; see notes. Values first recalled from memory were all verified against cited sources on 2026-10-13.
